title: Find All Good Strings
summary: Determine the count of valid strings of length n that are lexicographically between s1 and s2 and do not include the substring evil, returning the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Determine the count of valid strings of length n that are lexicographically between s1 and s2 and do not include the substring evil, returning the result modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: s1 and s2 are lowercase strings of length n with s1 <= s2.
Count strings in that inclusive range that do not contain evil; return modulo 1,000,000,007.
hints: Track position, matched evil-prefix length, and whether each lexical bound is still tight.
